name: drop
about: Floor: the window that cuts in steps, like ACE. Past the budget it keeps the newest messages that fit 0.6 of it, from a user message, and then only appends until the budget again, so its prefix stays cached between cuts. No layer. Port of ace_bench's Drop. The fold share 0.6 is the value that ace_bench passed to it in the runs of Nov 9 2026 (ace.FOLD_TO then; ACE has 0.9 now).
